images.title: Find deleted orders
images.description: Search a period for deleted orders, keep only the ones not canceled, sort by deletion or creation date and select the ones to restore.

images.title: See what was deleted
images.description: Click an order to see the full data of its deletion before you restore it.

images.title: Canceled orders too
images.description: Leave Only not canceled off to list orders that were canceled when deleted, marked with a Canceled badge.

images.title: Restore in one click
images.description: Restore the selected orders with their original number and data. The page shows how many were restored and refreshes the list.
